candidates.prompt_content: Evaluate the original task goal without weakening it and return its verdict in `verdict`. When the current bounded execution unit has a separately falsifiable completion condition, also return `unit_verdict` as PASS, FAIL, or UNCERTAIN with evidence and reason. A passing unit never implies the original task passed. Preserve negative evidence and the strict external claim boundary.
candidates.risk: An overlay could overproduce unit PASS; regression must require explicit bounded success conditions and preserve original verdict independence.
candidates.what_it_changes: Require separate original-goal and bounded-unit verdicts when their outcomes differ.
